events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.
I'll build a single self-contained page: a dark, steaming vegan ramen bowl drawn entirely in inline SVG, CSS, and JavaScript, with mouse-driven warmth and a reduced-motion path.
The page will be one HTML file: an inline SVG bowl, a canvas steam layer, and mouse-driven light, with motion turned off when the system asks for it.

events.content:
`index.html` is a single dark scene with one steaming bowl of vegan ramen and nothing else on the page.

- The bowl, broth, noodles, tofu, scallions, shiitake, nori, corn, bok choy, menma, sesame, and chili oil are all inline SVG.
- Steam rises from the surface on a canvas. Moving the pointer tilts the bowl, shifts a warm light, slides the broth sheen, and bends the steam.
- The layout scales with the viewport. When `prefers-reduced-motion` is set, the tilt, drift, and rising steam stop and a still wisp remains.
